epoch_initialization: Fresh capital and empty shadow history; no imported historical profits. Warmup only contains feature data.
execution: Fresh observed ask for long entry, bid for short entry, adverse slippage; exits at fresh opposite book after observed stop/target/time. Previous OHLC never becomes a retroactive fill.
entry_latency: CORE and REV1H wait until knowledge timestamp+1+15min. SHORT20D may enter on first fresh quote after its 4h signal. LONG shadow score gating preserved with new execution prices.
risk_model: 15-minute observation; intrabar stop priority; both-hit ambiguity recorded. Execution and monitoring differ from R17.11 backtest; this is a new paper variant, not a validated reproduction of its returns.
